fact: Per Hespress (29 May 2025), the Interior Ministry's local finance directorate (DFCT/DGCT), with the Treasury (TGR), instructed provincial services to use GIR-CT exclusively to upload revenue orders (ordres de recettes) issued per tax, to abandon locally acquired software, and to move to collecting those orders through the same system and sending them electronically to public accountants; a TGR-partnered online platform takes declarations and payments of local taxes.
title: Casablanca-Settat : mobilisation des autorités pour renforcer la collecte des taxes locales et éviter la prescription
